sv.title: Pojke kidnappades – hittad efter tre dygn
sv.summary: En 15-årig pojke som kidnappades i Karlskoga i fredags hittades på måndagen i en stor polisinsats i Örebro. Flera personer har gripits misstänkta för människorov.

en.title: Boy kidnapped – found after three days
en.summary: A 15-year-old boy who was kidnapped in Karlskoga on Friday was found on Monday in a large police operation in Örebro. Several people have been arrested on suspicion of kidnapping.
